# Podacium

> The Algerian & MENA Unified Ecosystem for Education, Freelancing, and Business Intelligence.

Podacium is an integrated multi-module platform founded in 2025 and operated by Podacium SARL in Oran, Algeria. It serves students, freelancers, enterprise clients, and data analysts across Algeria and the broader MENA region.

## Platform Pillars

- **Learn (Education)**: High-production interactive coursework, structured learning paths, quizzes, and verifiable digital certificates.
  - Courses: https://podacium.com/learn/courses
  - Learning Paths: https://podacium.com/learn/paths
- **Hub (Freelance Market)**: Curated talent marketplace connecting skilled Algerian and MENA freelancers with local and international businesses. Features milestone escrows, dispute resolution, and skill-matched discovery.
  - Explore Projects: https://podacium.com/hub/projects
  - Find Freelancers: https://podacium.com/hub/freelancers
- **BI (Business Intelligence)**: Enterprise-grade business intelligence and collaborative analytics platform with custom SQL workbenches, interactive dashboard widgets, dataset lineage, and automated reporting.
  - BI Overview: https://podacium.com/bi
  - Analytics: https://podacium.com/bi/analytics
  - Dashboards: https://podacium.com/bi/dashboards
  - Datasets: https://podacium.com/bi/datasets

## Key Facts & Geographic Context

- **Legal Entity**: Podacium SARL
- **Headquarters**: Es-Senia, Oran 31000, Algeria
- **Legal Compliance**: Compliant with Algerian Law 18-07 on personal data protection and commercial regulations.
- **Accepted Payment Rails**: Domestic Algerian electronic payments via EDAHABIA (Algérie Poste), CIB (interbank network), SATIM, and Chargily Pay in Algerian Dinars (DZD), alongside international payments (EUR / USD).
- **Supported Languages**: Multilingual interface in English (`en`), French (`fr`), Arabic (`ar`, RTL), and Kabyle / Tamazight (`kab`, Latin script, LTR).
